summary: Independent design review approves the frozen Windows non-overwriting initialization contract with no open findings. Reviewed current standing authorization, specification, risk facts, REVIEW/V2 classification, current canonical design context and true pre-production base fb89032. The three initialization modules are absent and cli.py/policy.py match current main. A focused baseline observation collected 137 skips solely because implementation sources are absent; it is not implementation or acceptance evidence. Allowed scope explicitly bounds five governed production files and four exact task-free companion test paths; tests remain separate work/commits and fully included in future candidate review/CI, with production impact scope and the original diff baseline preserved. The contract reuses existing bundle, Schema/Policy loader and pure verification parser, fixes service/CLI and portable WinAPI seams and x64 ABI, restricts apply/resume to CPython 3.11 Windows local NTFS, and refuses unsupported targets or Node relabeling. The minimal native Python target is an initialization fixture, not proof of executable external-engine V0/V1/V2. All prior pre-review issues are addressed: preview/review/state hashes establish content/current-fact consistency without source or identity authentication; all twenty resources and three metadata objects retain same-object protection through publication and final checking; pure plan parsing uses an explicit constant callback without tool probing; identity publication is preceded by a bounded final Git/index/non-install worktree recheck. Explicit input, file/count/aggregate/index/Git-output/time limits fail closed. Fixed handle-relative NtCreateFile exclusive creation obtains the created object directly; reviewed retained native prototype results support same-object FILE_CREATED, collision preservation, sharing exclusion and absolute no-replace identity rename, while relative rename failure remains unsupported and preserved. The design distinguishes these primitive experiments from pending complete service fault/race/interruption acceptance, does not claim whole-tree atomic locking, same-user adversary isolation or power-loss transactions, and does not delete unknown content. Fresh/verified-partial/verified-complete states preserve UUID and bytes; ready checks allow normal later task history while strict original-preview replay rejects drift. Target Policy adoption binds exact selected bytes and does not transfer source authorization or maintenance mode; migration is read-only. Scope and external effects are restricted to disposable synthetic application targets, credential-free anonymous public build dependencies and conditional exact-ref same-repository delivery. Actual implementation, native Windows/portable tests, installed wheel acceptance, separately reviewed current single-use mutation action, independent full V2 with unchanged 85/90 quality thresholds, implementation review/code approval/Gate and exact-head required CI remain pending. This design approval authorizes none of mutation execution, real agent-bridge application, Node verification, external-engine V2, source authorization changes or merge readiness. Private originals remain local and future public content requires the stated audit.
